title: Autograph
desc: Senthil, an advertising executive, decides to invite his old friends to his wedding. His past is unraveled as he sets out on a journey to meet his old friends and lovers.

title: Kavari Maan
desc: In a moment of rage, a man destroys his family after uncovering his wife's betrayal. Later, he tries to reconnect with his daughter who refuses to forgive him.

title: Priyamudan
desc: Vasanth, the son of a wealthy businessman, falls in love with Priya when he visits Rajasthan. He impersonates a man named Vasanth Kumar, who had saved her life before, in order to woo her.

title: Kuttrapathirikai
desc: After the assassination of the prime minister, two police officials must work together with a special officer to uncover the organisation behind the crime.

title: Chanakya
desc: Arjun, a highly sought-after RAW agent, is known for his skills at catching some of the most hardened criminals. However, he falls in danger when he goes after Ibrahim Qureshi, a terrorist.
